name: refine-loop
description: The loop pattern (a healing gate without rollback): a drafter writes or improves the artifact at --arg file=, a readonly reviewer judges it from the ROUND'S OWN recorded change (node_diff - a live capture inside a loop body is wrong from round 2), and a deterministic severity gate heals the drafter up to 2 rounds with rollback: false, so each round BUILDS ON the last instead of undoing it. The engine names the round in the drafter's repair prompt. on_exhausted: 'pass' accepts the best-so-far when rounds run out - never silently: the recorded verdict reads 'accepted after N rounds without resolving: ...', and the final node prints it. verify --lint names the gate (lint-on-exhausted-pass); for this flow that is the lint working, not a defect: this gate is a refinement loop, not a quality bar.

cmd:
import sys, json
v = sys.argv[1]
try:
    v = json.loads(v)
except ValueError:
    pass
print('refine-loop outcome: ' + str(v))
